blocks.text: Businessman Vincent Co, husband of actress Bea Alonzo, was spotted at a sports event in Cavite on Saturday, Sept. 19. Co arrived at the venue in Imus, Cavite wearing a white shirt and black shorts. He greeted Alonzo’s manager, Chris Cahilig, before briefly leaving the area. Alonzo did not accompany her husband at the event. The sighting came after Co and Alonzo went on their honeymoon in Europe following their intimate civil wedding in July.
